## Context

The terminal render path got its perf overhaul in `dda8a4f0` (cellRenderer row-sig diff, renderless EddyTerm, dirty-row linkify, deck strip remount fix). The rest of the SPA — sidebar, store/sync ingestion, deck switching, palette, chrome, CSS — was written correctness-first and audited this session by 5 scouts (full reports: `agent://SidebarScout`, `agent://StoreSyncScout`, `agent://DeckPaneScout`, `agent://ShellChromeScout`, `agent://TimerCssScout`). Root-cause chain: **(a)** every agent WS fold object-replaces the nested `session.agent` (projector shallow-merge), **(b)** zero `batch()`/`reconcile` in the sync layer, **(c)** sidebar/palette/home lists are `<For>` over freshly-allocated objects → reference-keyed reconciliation tears down and recreates ALL r…

Stack facts (verified): SolidJS 1.9 + single `createStore` root (`apps/web/src/store/root.ts`), selectors in `store/selectors.ts`, live WS sync stream (`store/sync*.ts`). "Re-render" here = computation re-run / DOM recreation, not VDOM. Working tree carries unrelated in-flight agent-config WIP (`AgentGlyph.tsx`, `AgentLaunchButton.tsx`, `lib/agents.ts`, `apps/coord/src/agent-config*`, `Settings/AgentLauncherPane.tsx`, modified `main.tsx`/`CellTerminal.tsx`/`cellRenderer.ts` etc.) — do not touch, revert, or commit those files; work around them.

CLAUDE.md L11 governs: no sidebar redesigns (additive changes only, smoke must pass after each phase); never force `_doRender` in byte handlers; grep L11 before touching any listed symptom area.

## Approach

Lanes A–D are independent of each other and can run as parallel subagent lanes. Steps inside a lane are ordered. Every step must leave `bun test apps/web` green (run `cd <repo-root> && bun test apps/web`).

### Lane A — store write path, then sidebar (A1 → A2 → A3)

#### A1. Granular store writes + batching (foundation — do first; A3/C1 depend on it)

1. **`apps/web/src/store/projector.ts` `foldEventIntoStore`** — the session write at :65 is `setRootStore("sessions", id, s)`: shallow merge, so the nested `agent` object (rebuilt as `{...s, agent: {...base, ...e.patch}}` by `apps/shared/src/wire/event.ts:160-166`) is object-REPLACED per agent fold → every `s.agent?.*` reader app-wide invalidates per tick. Change to:
   ```ts
   import { reconcile } from "solid-js/store";
   if (rootStore.sessions[id]) setRootStore("sessions", id, reconcile(s));
   else setRootStore("sessions", id, s);
   ```
   `foldEvent` returns a COMPLETE Session object (prior spread + patch), so `reconcile` against the full object is safe. Verify that at `event.ts:160-166` before editing; if any fold path returns a partial, instead keep the shallow top-level merge and reconcile only the subtree: `setRootStore("sessions", id, "agent", reconcile(nextAgent))`. Note: `store/paneLayout.ts` exports an unrelated local function also named `reconcile` — the import here is `solid-js/store`, keep them straight.
2. **Wrap multi-write paths in `batch()`** (import from `solid-js`): the deletion path in projector (3 writes, projector.ts:56-61), the snapshot-apply loop (K sessions → K writes), each WS frame's handling in the `_runConnectSync` switch (`store/sync.ts:145-296`), and the reconnect backfill replay loop (each replayed event is currently its own flush — wrap the whole replay in one `batch()`).
3. **`apps/web/src/store/sync-routable.ts:14`** — the routable signal fires on every frame because callers pass a fresh `Set`. Add equality:
   ```ts
   const [routableFps, setRoutableFps] = createSignal<Set<string> | null>(null, {
     equals: (a, b) => a !== null && b !== null && a.size === b.size && [...b].every((f) => a.has(f)),
   });
   ```
   (Adapt to the file's actual initial value — re-read it; the option object is the change.) Callers (`sync.ts:288`, `sync-bootstrap.ts:123,218`) stay unchanged.
4. **`apps/web/src/store/sync-bootstrap.ts` `refreshCoordAndWorkers` (:96-152) and `_bootstrap` (:253)** — `setRootStore("workers", rec)` merges a record of all-new worker objects → every `workers[fp]` subscriber invalidates on every tab refocus. Replace with per-fp reconcile: `for (const [fp, w] of Object.entries(rec)) setRootStore("workers", fp, reconcile(w))` inside one `batch()`. Keep the no-delete semantics (missing fps are not removed — same as today).
5. **`apps/web/src/store/sync.ts:253`** session_viewers array-replace → `setRootStore("session_viewers", sid, reconcile(entries, { key: "fp" }))` — stable entry identity means `ViewersChip.tsx`'s existing `<For>` keeps avatar DOM with no component change.
6. **`apps/web/src/store/sync.ts:164`** — hoist the per-frame `await import("@eddy/shared/wire/event-proto")` to a single top-of-stream (or module-level) import.
7. **`apps/web/src/store/sync-dispatch.ts:56-77` `_parseOsc7` sticky carry** — line 76 retains the FULL text as carry whenever no OSC7 matched, so after the first ESC-containing chunk every subsequent chunk pays decode+concat+regex forever, per session, viewed or not. Fix: retain a carry ONLY when the text ends in an unterminated OSC7 candidate — keep the tail from the last `\x1b]7;` occurrence that has no `\x07`/`\x1b\\` terminator after it; otherwise set carry to `""` (restores the :58 fast path). Keep the existing carry size cap.
8. **JWT cache — `apps/web/src/auth/web-key.ts` `signCoordinatorJwt` (:128-143)** — payload is `{sub:"web", aud, iat}` only (no per-RPC claims); coord accepts `iat + jwtMaxAgeSecs(default 300, apps/shared/src/config.ts:26) >= now`. Currently a fresh Ed25519 sign runs per RPC — including one per keystroke via `ws/input-channel.ts:96`. Add a module-level cache:
   ```ts
   let _cachedJwt: { token: string; iatMs: number } | null = null;
   // in signCoordinatorJwt: if (_cachedJwt && Date.now() - _cachedJwt.iatMs < 240_000) return _cachedJwt.token;
   ```
   240 s = 80 % of the 300 s default. Signature/async shape unchanged; all callers untouched. No invalidation edge: the keypair never rotates within a page life (IDB-cached, see `loadOrGenerate`).

#### A2. sessionSeen restructure (kills the `_seen` broadcast + localStorage storm)

**`apps/web/src/lib/sessionSeen.ts`** — currently `createSignal<Record<string,number>>(read(), { equals: false })`: every `markSeen` (even the monotonic no-op branch) notifies ALL `lastSeenAt` subscribers, and every real write does `JSON.stringify(entire map)` + `localStorage.setItem` synchronously; writers fire per agent tick (`FolderList.tsx:143-149`, `TerminalDeck.tsx:210-218`). Rewrite the module internals, keeping the exported API (`lastSeenAt`, `markSeen`, `seedSeenOnce`) byte-compatible:

- `const [_seen, _setSeen] = createStore<Record<string, number>>(read());` (`solid-js/store`) → per-id reactivity; `lastSeenAt(id)` returns `_seen[id] ?? 0`.
- `markSeen`: early-return when `(_seen[sessionId] ?? 0) >= ts` (no signal fire at all), else `_setSeen(sessionId, ts)` and schedule a debounced persist: one module-level trailing 500 ms timer that stringifies once; flush pending persist on `window.addEventListener("pagehide", flush)` so stamps survive tab close.
- `seedSeenOnce` unchanged (loops `markSeen`).

No caller changes. The FolderList (:143-149) and TerminalDeck (:210-218) effects keep their shape — after A1's reconcile, their `.agent.last_message.ts` dep fires only on real ts changes, and after this step `markSeen` no-ops silently.

#### A3. FolderList keyed rows + sidebar hygiene (depends on A1+A2)

1. **`apps/web/src/components/sidebar/FolderList.tsx`** — `groups` (:163-223) allocates fresh `FolderGroup[]` per run and `<For each={groups()}>` (:238) keys by reference → every invalidation disposes and recreates EVERY row's DOM (`<A>`, `<md-ripple>`, StatusGlyph, 3-5 SVGs, chips). Convert to a keyed store:
   ```ts
   const [gs, setGs] = createStore<{ rows: FolderGroup[] }>({ rows: [] });
   createComputed(() => setGs("rows", reconcile(buildGroups(), { key: "key" })));
   // JSX: <For each={gs.rows}>
   ```
   where `buildGroups()` is the current memo body verbatim. Rows with an unchanged `key` keep object identity → DOM survives; changed fields flow as fine-grained store updates because JSX reads `g.field` off store proxies.
   - **`FolderGroup` must become plain-scalar** (reconcile must not deep-diff live Session proxies): replace `lead: Session` → `leadId: string` and `sessions: Session[]` → `sessionIds: string[]`. Re-read the interface at :54-75 and map every field 1:1. Known in-file usages to update: `g.lead.id` at :227 (setOrderedSessionIds), :244 (folderRowTargetId arg), :256 (data-cursor); `g.sessions.map((s) => s.id)` at :265 (ctx-menu payload) → `g.sessionIds`; `g.sessions.length` at :290/:295 → `g.sessionIds.length`. Fields computed FROM `lead` (`isClaude`, `glyphStatus`, `subtitle`, `pr`, `branch`) are already scalars computed inside `buildGroups` — unchanged.
   - `{(relTimeTickMs(), relTimeSince(g.ageTs))}` at :277 keeps working: `g.ageTs` is now a reactive store read, ticker updates only text nodes.
2. **`apps/web/src/lib/lastVisited.ts`** — `getLastSessionForFolder` does `localStorage.getItem` + `JSON.parse` of the whole folder map on EVERY call, and FolderList calls it per row per rebuild (:244). Load the map once into a module-level signal at import (`const [_folderMap, _setFolderMap] = createSignal(readFolderMap())`); `getLastSessionForFolder` reads the signal (reactive), `rememberVisit` updates signal then writes localStorage. Keep exported signatures. Also add a write-skip in `rememberVisit` when the stored value is already identical.
3. **`apps/web/src/lib/sidebarCursor.ts` `setOrderedSessionIds` (:28-31)** — publishes a fresh array per call with default ref equality → echo invalidation of every row's `data-cursor` after each groups run. Add a guard: compare to the previous array (length + elementwise `===`) and skip the set when equal.
4. **`apps/web/src/components/sidebar/SessionRow.tsx:121-128`** — delete the dead `wsId` memo (zero readers in file; it eagerly scans `Object.entries(rootStore.workspaces)` per mounted row). Verify with `grep -n "wsId" apps/web/src/components/sidebar/SessionRow.tsx` → only the def site.
5. **`apps/web/src/components/sidebar/AllView.tsx`** — (a) the results gate at :129 uses raw `query()` while rows use `debouncedQuery()` (:65) → first keystroke unmounts FolderList into an empty pane for 120 ms; gate both on `debouncedQuery()`. (b) `filteredSessions` (:64-72) reads `s.agent?.last_message?.text` of every session → any token-batch re-runs the O(n) filter + `toLowerCase` allocs while search is open; wrap the message-text read in `untrack(...)`. Decision: search results match against message text as of the last query change, not live-updating per token — acceptable for a search box.

### Lane B — deck/pane switch latency + interaction churn (independent; touches L11-guarded terminal territory → Lane B alone triggers the eddy-smoke + render-stress gates in Verification)

1. **Claim debounce bypass on intent — `apps/web/src/components/CellTerminal.tsx`**. `scheduleClaim` (:296-302) routes ALL claims through the 150 ms viewport-wobble debounce (`CLAIM_DEBOUNCE_MS`, :96), including the TAB_VISIBLE re-claim on the inLayout flip (:731-738), visibilitychange (:803-806), and pageshow (:819-822) — a hard +150 ms on every session switch before the worker even starts streaming. Change: at those three intent-bearing sites call `sendClaim()` directly, first clearing any pending debounce timer (so no double-send); ResizeObserver-driven claims (:762-766) keep the debounce (that's what it exists for — L11 "viewport-slaved PTY" row). 
2. **Double-withdraw fix — same file**. Pane hide sends withdraw at :732-735, then the off-screen park to 800×600 fires that pane's RO → `scheduleClaim` → `sendClaim` sees `inLayout===false` → withdraws AGAIN (:206-220). Track the last-sent state per instance (`let _lastSent: "claim" | "withdraw" | null`) and make `sendClaim` early-return when it would send a withdraw while `_lastSent === "withdraw"`. Reset `_lastSent` on claim.
3. **Focus-gate memo — same file, :742-745**. The effect reads raw `props.inLayout && props.focused` (prop getters deref the deck's slot memo) → re-runs `queueMicrotask(term.forceFocus())` per drag frame / layout commit / deck RO tick. Copy the sibling `inLayoutFlag` pattern documented at :725-731: `const focusGate = createMemo(() => props.inLayout === true && props.focused === true);` and have the effect track only `focusGate()`.

The effect subscribes to `sessionTitle()` of EVERY tab (title/tool/message churn) and stacks uncanceled rAFs doing `offsetLeft/offsetWidth` reads. 61:
62:   | User says | Reframe as |
63:   |---|---|

98:      rules (L0, L1-L4, L6-L11, plus any future L12+ per L9.5

120:   - **Parallel-batch independent calls in one message.** Multiple
